channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Supreme Court pauses ruling restricting TV ad discount for GOP
item.description: A Supreme Court stay over a broadcast ad discount reopens a decades-old question about whether parties and candidates deserve equal treatment under campaign finance law.

item.title: Messi leads Inter Miami against Tata Martino's Atlanta United
item.description: Messi plays his first match since retiring from Argentina duty as Inter Miami host Atlanta United and former coach Tata Martino on Saturday night.

item.title: Wheaton Unity Festival to kick off Hispanic Heritage Month on Sept. 19
item.description: Montgomery County's free Wheaton festival on September 19 opens Hispanic Heritage Month with live music, food, and family fun near the Metro.

item.title: Tigres host Necaxa in Liga MX Apertura matchday 7
item.description: Tigres host Necaxa on September 6 needing a win to climb out of 16th place, with midfielder Fernando Gorriarán suspended.

item.title: Judge extends block on Trump mail-voting executive order ahead of midterms
item.description: A federal judge in Boston issued a preliminary injunction blocking a USPS rule tied to Trump's March 2026 mail-voting executive order.

item.title: Colombia faces worst fiscal crisis in 50 years, tax hike warned
item.description: Deputy Finance Minister Andrés Quevedo calls Colombia's fiscal position the worst in half a century, as a tax hike and deep spending cuts loom.

item.title: Forlán names first Uruguay squad with five Liga MX players
item.description: Diego Forlán's 46-man preliminary roster for three September–October friendlies draws from five continents, with Liga MX supplying a notable five players.

item.title: ICE officer Castro pleads not guilty to lying about Minneapolis shooting
item.description: A federal grand jury indicted the ICE officer on six counts of making false statements to the FBI about a January shooting in Minneapolis.

item.title: Bartiromo lawyer denies firing, says she remains Fox employee
item.description: Attorney Bryan Freedman says Maria Bartiromo remains a Fox News employee, directly contradicting the network's Thursday announcement of her departure.

item.title: Judge issues preliminary injunction blocking USPS mail-ballot rule
item.description: A Boston federal judge blocked a USPS mail-ballot rule tied to a Trump executive order, finding voter disenfranchisement 'practically inevitable' if it stood.

item.title: Missouri Supreme Court blocks 2025 House map, orders November referendum
item.description: The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously invalidated the 2025 congressional map and ordered voters to decide its fate in November.

item.title: Supreme Court pauses 4th Circuit ruling on political ad rates
item.description: A four-page Supreme Court order freezing a mid-campaign ad-rate ruling opens a window onto decades of tension between broadcast law and campaign finance.

item.title: Minneapolis shooting and mayor's proposed violence-interrupter cuts converge
item.description: A fatal shooting at a Minneapolis high-rise and proposed cuts to violence-interrupter funding have collided in the city's public safety debate.

item.title: Trump sends Witkoff and Kushner to Moscow and Kyiv for peace talks
item.description: President Trump dispatched Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to meet with Putin and Zelensky on consecutive days in pursuit of a Ukraine ceasefire.

item.title: Judge blocks Trump's second executive order on birthright citizenship
item.description: A federal judge in Maryland blocked enforcement of President Trump's August 2026 birthright citizenship executive order, calling it almost certainly unconstitutional.

item.title: Jenni Rivera's 2011 Staples Center concert released as live album
item.description: The late queen of regional Mexican music sells out Staples Center all over again, fifteen years later, with a landmark 45-song release.

item.title: White House launches arcade website with five policy-themed games
item.description: The Trump administration debuted five retro-style policy games on the official White House website Thursday, drawing attention ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Beyoncé's B'Day deluxe edition features Maluma, Selena and Celia Cruz
item.description: The superstar dropped a 31-track deluxe edition of B'Day on her 45th birthday, and the Latin collaborations are everything.

item.title: Trump threatens trade halt with Mexico if Fed won't cut rates
item.description: Trump threatened to halt trade with deficit countries unless the Fed cuts rates, putting Mexico's $27.5 billion monthly gap in the crosshairs.

item.title: Milei tightens Falklands oil sanctions and plans naval base
item.description: Milei targets Rockhopper and Navitas Petroleum with expanded sanctions and announces a new Tierra del Fuego naval base over Falklands oil drilling.

item.title: Milei escalates Falklands dispute after Trump questions U.S.-UK backing
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei announced sanctions against oil firms near the Falklands after Trump declined to affirm U.S. support for Britain.

item.title: Court blocks Trump birthright order as TPS, ICE fear grip Latinos
item.description: A federal judge blocks Trump's birthright citizenship order as Salvadoran TPS expires and ICE fears cancel Latino festivals nationwide.

item.title: Mexican cartels escalate use of car bombs and explosive drones
item.description: A car bomb outside a Zacatecas police station injured 11 people as explosive attacks by Mexican cartels reach record frequency in 2026.

item.title: Election officials say Trump's USPS mail-ballot rule is too late to implement
item.description: A federal judge blocked parts of the rule, the Supreme Court partially revived it, and election officials say compliance remains impossible before November.

item.title: Messi's Argentina retirement raises questions about Inter Miami future
item.description: Messi retires from Argentina duty after 207 caps and a World Cup title, but his Inter Miami contract runs through 2028.

item.title: House passes bill cutting federal funds from universities boycotting Israel
item.description: A bipartisan House vote to tie federal funds to Israeli-boycott policies reopens a century-old tension between government spending conditions and constitutional speech protections.

item.title: Ibama clears Petrobras to drill three more Foz do Amazonas wells
item.description: Ibama signed off on three exploratory wells in block FZA-M-59 off Amapá, pushing Petrobras closer to a verdict on its Morpho hydrocarbon find.

item.title: Inter Miami signs Paraguayan midfielder Matías Galarza on loan
item.description: The 24-year-old Paraguayan international arrives on loan from River Plate through the 2026 MLS season, with a buy option attached.

item.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to lift block on mail-ballot restrictions
item.description: The administration told the justices that a lower-court block on mail-ballot restrictions will cause irreparable harm ahead of the November midterms.

item.title: North Dakota special session passes kratom regulation, rejects total ban
item.description: The North Dakota Legislature rejected a total kratom prohibition and instead passed a regulatory framework banning synthetic kratom while restricting natural kratom sales to adults.

item.title: Trump threatens trade cutoff with deficit countries if Fed won't cut rates
item.description: Trump threatened to halt trade with deficit countries unless the Federal Reserve cuts interest rates, escalating his public clash with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

item.title: Labor Dept. OIG report details misconduct by ex-secretary Chavez-DeRemer
item.description: The Labor Department's watchdog found the former secretary violated alcohol policies, directed staff on personal tasks, and oversaw a hostile work environment.

item.title: Romanian prosecutors indict Andrew Tate on trafficking and sex charges
item.description: Romanian anti-organized crime prosecutors formally charged Andrew and Tristan Tate on September 4, 2026, while the brothers remain in U.S. custody.

item.title: Trump expected to sign beef executive order Friday
item.description: Two sources told Reuters the president is set to sign an order tied to country-of-origin labeling at 1:30 p.m. ET Friday.

item.title: Mexico and US show uneven recovery as USMCA review tests AI governance
item.description: Mexico's economy stumbled in early 2026, rebounded unevenly, and now faces a USMCA review that puts AI rules and data policy at the center.

item.title: Márquez weighs Romero and Campillo for first Mexico call-up
item.description: Márquez's first squad announcement arrives the week of September 14–18, with Romero's national-team choice and Campillo's Liga MX form both unresolved.

item.title: Latino voters emerge as key swing bloc in 2026 midterms
item.description: With 36.2 million eligible Latino voters representing 15 percent of the national electorate, both parties are competing aggressively for a bloc that could decide competitive races.

item.title: AFA orders nationwide minute of applause for retired Messi
item.description: The AFA ordered a 60-second applause pause at the 10th minute of every domestic match to honor Messi's retirement from the national team.

item.title: All-Liga MX final set for 2026 Leagues Cup on September 6
item.description: All four semifinalists are Liga MX clubs, ending MLS's three-year winning streak and guaranteeing a Mexican champion on September 6.

item.title: US adds 162,000 jobs in August, beating forecasts
item.description: The Labor Department's August payroll count of 162,000 far exceeded Wall Street forecasts and marked the strongest monthly gain since March.
